passages.title: Password update on Friday
passages.text:
To: All Employees
From: IT Department
Subject: Password update on Friday

On Friday evening, the IT Department will install a new security system on all company computers. After the update, every employee will be asked to [1] a new password. The new password must be at least ten characters long and [2] one number. [3] Your old password will no longer work after that time. If you forget your new password, you can [4] it online in just a few minutes. Please save your work before leaving the office on Friday. Technicians will be available all evening. If you have a problem, please call the help desk at extension 210.

Thank you for your understanding.

why.vi: Sau "be asked to" cần động từ nguyên mẫu: "create" (tạo).
why.en: After "be asked to" we need a base verb: "create".

questions.trap: "creation" là danh từ nên không đứng sau "to" ở đây.

why.vi: "must be ... and contain": hai vế cùng sau "must", nên dùng động từ nguyên mẫu "contain".
why.en: "must be ... and contain": both verbs follow "must", so we use the base form "contain".

options: The update will begin at 6:00 P.M.
The company cafeteria has a new menu.
Computers are available for rent at the front desk.
Printers on the third floor were repaired last week.

why.vi: Câu sau nói "after that time", nên câu chèn phải nêu một mốc giờ: 6:00 P.M.
why.en: The next sentence says "after that time", so the missing sentence must give a time: 6:00 P.M.

questions.trap: Các câu còn lại không có mốc thời gian để "that time" nói tới.

why.vi: Sau "can" cần động từ nguyên mẫu: "reset" (đặt lại mật khẩu).
why.en: After "can" we need a base verb: "reset".
